evals.prompt: Add an omp command /thinking off that hides thinking blocks already on screen. I don't want this in the omp repo.
evals.expected_output: An extension under ~/.omp/agent/extensions/<name>/index.ts (or <name>.ts), auto-discovered with no config.yml entry; restart noted. No oh-my-pi edits.

evals.prompt: Can we hide those short 'let me look at the file' lines in omp, like calm mode, but leave the real reply? Don't touch the working row.
evals.expected_output: Presentation-only extension. updateContent wrap. No working-row replacement. No omp source edit.

evals.prompt: The /usage command in omp prints the wrong token count. Fix it in oh-my-pi.
evals.expected_output: Not an extension: a repo change. Branch off origin/main in a worktree, fix, bun check + bun test, push to the fork, add .omp-build/branches/<branch>.toml on fork main through a worktree or PR, dispatch omp-build, then prove the installed binary changed.

evals.prompt: I made a branch with a session-listing tweak. Get it into my omp.
evals.expected_output: Push the branch to fork, probe the assembly with scripts/probe-build.sh --add <branch>, add .omp-build/branches/<branch>.toml on fork main through a worktree or PR, dispatch omp-build, then mise up and prove the branch's string is in $(mise which omp). omp --version is not proof.

evals.prompt: The daily omp build failed and there's a conflict issue open on the fork.
evals.expected_output: Read the issue's conflicting files, reproduce locally with the probe, merge upstream (never rebase or force-push a listed branch), push, re-dispatch, close the issue.

evals.prompt: omp on the VPS is stale / a release broke sessions. Get me back to a working one.
evals.expected_output: Pin the known-good tag in the machine-local ~/.config/mise/config.local.toml, mise install, prove the binary has the feature; remove the block and mise up once a fixed release is Latest.
